results.title: Guides and Surveys, intégré à l'application
results.content:
Guides and Surveys est entièrement intégré au reste de la plateforme Amplitude (Analytics, Expérimentation, Session Replay, etc.), ce qui vous permet de créer des messages et des enquêtes ciblés en fonction du comportement des utilisateurs. Avec Amplitude, vous pouvez agir sur vos insights en un seul endroit, au sein d'une plateforme unifiée.

Ce n'est pas le concept que nous rejetons, c'est la paresse dans sa réalisation. Guides and Surveys est conçu pour améliorer l'expérience utilisateur, et non pour l'interrompre. Les guides et les enquêtes contextuels apparaissent exactement au moment où ils sont utiles et nécessaires, sans frustrer vos utilisateurs. [...] Command AI était puissant, et l'ancienne équipe est incroyablement fière de ce qu'elle a construit. Mais avec les données comportementales inégalées d'Amplitude, Guides and Surveys atteint vraiment un tout autre niveau. Il combine l'intelligence de Command AI avec la profondeur et la précision de la plateforme Amplitude, rendant chaque guide et chaque enquête encore plus percutant pour vos utilisateurs.

En savoir plus sur l'acquisition de Command AI.

C'est très simple. Si vous utilisez déjà Amplitude, vous pouvez commencer à en créer immédiatement. Le plus difficile sera probablement de quitter votre fournisseur de pop-ups sous-performant.

results.title: Amplitude Launches Guides and Surveys to End Annoying Popups
results.content: # Amplitude Launches Guides and Surveys to End Annoying Popups. **SAN FRANCISCO, February 11, 2025**--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today Amplitude (Nasdaq: AMPL), the leading digital analytics platform, announced the launch of Guides and Surveys to help organizations improve onboarding and user engagement. Guides and Surveys allow teams to activate in-product guidance based on rich customer insights. From growth teams striving to personalize every user engagement to marketing teams optimizing in-product communications, and product teams deciphering how customer feedback compares to in-product action, Amplitude enables organizations to perform deep analysis of user experiences and discover new opportunities to engage. That’s why Amplitude is taking a different approach, using existing behavioral data to provide personalized guidance, prompts, and surveys that actually improve retention, drive engagement, and help users be more successful,"* says Francois Ajenstat, chief product officer at Amplitude. *"And by fully integrating Guides and Surveys into our platform, Amplitude becomes the one-stop platform where digital teams can take action on the data that matters most."*. Unlike traditional approaches to guides and surveys, Amplitude uses AI-based targeting and ‘annoyance monitoring’ to ensure guides are shown when and where users need them most. They can use Guides and Surveys to improve user onboarding, increase feature adoption, encourage product up-sells, and more including:. *"Amplitude's Guides and Surveys have helped us make experiments more effective and fast,"* says Rachel Strubhar, Homebase director of product growth. We're excited to continue using Amplitude to improve our customers' onboarding experiences, promote new features, and help users connect with sales."*. Guides and Surveys are the latest additions to Amplitude's integrated and easy-to-use platform, which also includes Analytics, Session Replay, Feature Experimentation, Web Experimentation, and Activation. When used together, they make Amplitude's Guides and Surveys even more powerful. Learn more about Amplitude Guides and Surveys and our Digital Analytics Platform on our blog. **About Amplitude**Amplitude is the leading digital analytics platform that helps companies unlock the power of their products. Amplitude guides companies every step of the way as they capture data they can trust, uncover clear insights about customer behavior, and take faster action. Amplitude is the best-in-class analytics solution for product, data, and marketing teams, ranked #1 in multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2025 Report.

results.title: Guias e pesquisas no aplicativo
results.content:
Os guias e as pesquisas estão totalmente integrados ao restante da plataforma Amplitude (Análise, Experimentação, Session Replay, etc.), para que você possa criar mensagens e pesquisas específicas com base no comportamento dos usuários. Com o Amplitude, você pode tomar medidas com base nos seus insights em um só lugar, dentro da mesma plataforma unificada.

Não odiamos o conceito, odiamos quando ele é aplicado de forma preguiçosa. Os guias e as pesquisas foram criados para aprimorar as experiências dos usuários, não para interrompê-las. Os guias e as pesquisas adaptados ao contexto aparecem exatamente quando são úteis e necessários, sem frustrar seus usuários. [...] Configure gatilhos que correspondam ao que os usuários querem fazer em cada momento. Ao mostrar informações relevantes de acordo com o contexto e o comportamento dos usuários no produto, é possível evitar confusões e cliques em excesso causados pela frustração.

### Meça a insatisfação para não frustrar os usuários

Ninguém gosta de ver janelas pop-up irritantes. Meça o grau de insatisfação dos usuários com suas sugestões para que você possa tomar medidas corretivas e limitar a quantidade de guias e pesquisas que aparecem para os usuários e que não interessam a eles.

### Sempre com o estilo da sua marca

Os guias e as pesquisas estão prontos para serem adaptados para sua marca: cores, fontes e tudo mais.

### Combine os guias e as pesquisas com esses produtos populares do Amplitude [...] O Command AI era uma solução poderosa, e a equipe anterior está incrivelmente orgulhosa do que construiu. Mas, com os dados de comportamento incomparáveis do Amplitude, os guias e as pesquisas estão em outro nível. Eles combinam a inteligência do Command AI com a profundidade e precisão da plataforma Amplitude, o que faz com que cada guia e pesquisa tenha ainda mais impacto para seus usuários.

Leia mais sobre a aquisição da Command AI.

É superfácil. Se você já usa o Amplitude, pode começar a criá-los imediatamente. A parte mais difícil será provavelmente se despedir do seu provedor de janelas pop-up que não dão resultado.

# Amplitude Guides and Surveys - Drive user engagement with perfectly-timed messages. 😍 Automatic measurement of user engagement or annoyance. I'm @james\_evans5 from Amplitude (former @Command AI co-founder/CEO), and I'm thrilled to share Amplitude Guides and Surveys. **Our Story:** When we started Command AI (now part of Amplitude), we saw a disconnect in how software engages with users — powerful capabilities were often hidden behind frustrating experiences, intrusive popups, and impersonal interactions. Amplitude Guides and Surveys isn't just another messaging tool — *it's a complete reimagining of how products should communicate with their users*. **What Makes This Different:** We've built an experience that truly respects and understands your users: **⚡ Smarter timing** that recognizes user context **🛡️ Built-in protections** against message fatigue **✨ Multiple form factors**, from subtle tooltips to full guides **😍 Automatic measurement** of user engagement or annoyance This launch is especially meaningful as it represents the first fruits of Command AI joining forces with Amplitude. We've combined Command AI's expertise in crafting seamless user experiences with Amplitude's deep analytics capabilities, creating something that's greater than the sum of its parts. Whether you're guiding new users through your product or gathering crucial feedback, you now have the tools to do it with intelligence and empathy. And to our early users whose feedback has been invaluable in shaping this product. We can't wait to see how you'll use Guides and Surveys to create more engaging, more human product experiences. @james\_evans5 @ChrisMessina Grats with the launch! So excited to see @Command AI find a home at Amplitude and resurface as Guides & Surveys. @james\_evans5 congrats on the launch — what's next for your team's work at Amplitude? Thanks, James Vinay, and Amplitude! We've been wanting these features for our own product at Amplitude and I've spoken to **tons** of customers who want better personalization, onboarding, and opportunities to interact with their users in seamless ways. As someone who has spent the last three years constantly experimenting with in-product engagement to drive PLG and PLS, this is an absolute game changer! Now Amplitude has upped the game and is using that same set of data to react to customer experiences and improve the experiences immediately.
